The following unmodified font files come from Telegram Desktop's pinned
Desktop App Toolkit lib_ui submodule:
https://github.com/desktop-app/lib_ui/tree/79c846fdf0327ff99d3efdc1cc4e11ef50bedc6d/fonts

Original name                 Application resource
OpenSans-Regular.ttf          telegram_open_sans_regular.ttf
OpenSans-SemiBold.ttf         telegram_open_sans_semibold.ttf
OpenSans-Italic.ttf            telegram_open_sans_italic.ttf
OpenSans-SemiBoldItalic.ttf   telegram_open_sans_semibold_italic.ttf

The files are in shared/src/commonMain/composeResources/font/.
The copyright and license attribution above is retained from their embedded
name tables. Only the resource filenames have changed.
